profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Pilot
profile.summary: Software engineer with a passion for automating repetitive tasks and building user-friendly products.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
•  Built a platform-agnostic migration service to cut migration time by 80% while moving 100K+ contracts into our system with 99% accuracy using Next.js, Nest.js, React, and PostgreSQL.
•  Architected child subscriptions for flagship clients to increase revenue by 14% during their product launches using Nest.js, Next.js, React, and PostgreSQL.
•  Led migration of the async job pipeline from pg-boss to Google Pub/Sub to eliminate a scaling bottleneck and drove adoption across the team using Nest.js and PostgreSQL.
•  Resolved recurring production database crashes by removing duplicate connections to cut active DB connections by 50% using Nest.js and PostgreSQL.
•  Onboarded 4 engineers and led technical knowledge transfer during the Recurly acquisition, ramping the team to ship independently within 3 weeks.
•  Re-architected report generation into an async pipeline with polling and status tracking to reduce report timeout errors by 100% and improve UX using Next.js, Nest.js, React, and PostgreSQL.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · Software Design · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Jest · NestJS · Node.js

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Led and developed automated reports to improve migration times by 90% when moving companies to the LLC platform using Typescript, React, Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.
•  Built data import REST APIs with a spreadsheet UI to expedite client onboarding by 3.5X using Typescript, React, Java, Spring, and PostgreSQL.
•  Implemented seamless document signing experiences using React and Typescript to save clients 100s of hours each year.
•  Saved $1,000s in lawyer fees by automating SAFEs issuance using Typescript, React, Python, and Django.
•  Optimized law firm dashboard load time by 23% and improved UX with lazy loading using Python, Django, PostgreSQL, React, and Typescript and presented optimization techniques to 30+ engineers.
•  Spearheaded initiative to reduce storage usage by 90% by eliminating duplicated cap table data using Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: React / Typescript / Javascript / Django / Python / Spring / Java / Docker / Jest / Pytest

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Automated inventory metrics using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, HTML5, and CSS3 to generate reports resulting in a 90% decrease in manual data analysis and increasing inventory management by 2x.
• Built custom drag & drop interface to simplify billing operations by 20% using React, JavaScript, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, HTML5, and CSS3.
• Created product availability tracking and saved $140,000+ annually using Ruby on Rails, React, JavaScript, HTML5, & CSS3.
• Improved loading time for product catalog by 500% through optimizing queries and implementing infinite load using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, React, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3. 
• Created sales and labor cost analyzer to forecast overhead costs to save $1,000s annually using React, JavaScript, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, HTML5, and CSS3.
• Built nutrition upload tool using Javascript, React, Ruby on Rails, and PostgreSQL to gather nutrition data which increased nutritional transparency by 50%.
• Increased client retention by 4.5% by building product tagging using React Native & JavaScript.
• Wrote comprehensive unit tests with Ruby & Rspec resulting in 1.5x less bugs.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · TypeScript · React.js · HTML · Ruby on Rails · Stack · Problem Solving · PostgreSQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Jest · Distributed Systems · Technical Design · Web Development

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
• Expanded automation library to verify emails using Python, Gmail API, Selenium, and Robot Framework to guarantee customers are receiving leads and improving time to catch system failures by 3X.
• Automated end to end verification of core business functionalities using Python, JavaScript, Selenium, and Robot Framework, preventing regression and optimizing QA team’s testing time by over 20%.
• Improved automation suites to verify new platform features using Python, JavaScript, Selenium, and Robot Framework, minimizing testing suite runtime by more than 25%.
• Reduced time spent executing automation by 50% through configuring continuous integration with Jenkins.
• Executed full regression and exploratory testing preventing bugs potentially costing company $10,000 per day.
• Created 75+ comprehensive test cases using TestRail based on business and design requirements.
• Tested more than 50 APIs using SoapUI to ensure they met requirements and could handle erroneous input.
• Automated testing for forum site using Robot Framework, Selenium, HTML5, and CSS3 saving QA team 1 week per month in testing time (roughly $120K in savings annually).
positions.insights: Skills: Stack · Problem Solving · Technical Design · Web Development

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Automated data entry with VBA and Excel to extract and load data leading to 90% reduction in data entry time.
• Engineered validation layer using VBA resulting in 90% reduction in manual data validation and increased accuracy of analysis software.
• Streamlined data collection process by creating 35+ front-end forms in JavaScript, jQuery, HTML5, and CSS3.
• Built frontend form validation using JavaScript, jQuery, HTML5, and CSS3, preventing data entry errors while reducing server load by more than 50%.
• Implemented backend validation in C# and ASP.NET preventing 2 security exploits and maintain data integrity.
• Scripted CRUD stored procedures using SQL Server on 150+ table database resulting in 50% reduction in data access and update time compared to previous VBA and Excel platform.
positions.insights: Skills: Stack · Problem Solving · Technical Design · Web Development

projects.title: Stock Trakr
projects.description:
Stock tracking web app with friend functionality built while learning Ruby on Rails. 
Built using Devise authentication for login, styled with Bootstrap 3, Postgres for the database, and stock data is pulled live from Yahoo. Configured to run on Heroku.

https://github.com/stanleyisyoung/stock_trakr
